## J2ME-NXX v0.8.14

- App groups: the app list now has tabs. **All** is fixed; the other groups (**Favorites** by default) can be renamed, deleted and added (up to 12). Switch tabs with left / right or by tapping. Press **ZL** on an app to add it to / remove it from groups, or to create a new group with it. Groups are saved in `sdmc:/switch/j2me-nxx/groups.ini`.
- New side **Menu** (**X**): every action is gathered in a panel on the right — for the selected app (Open, Groups, Options, Backup, Delete), for the open group (Rename, Delete group) and general ones (New group, Settings, Rescan, Update, Exit). Each item shows its shortcut button, and the old shortcuts still work.
- The bottom bar now only shows **R** Upload game, **X** Menu and **A** Open. Settings moved into the Menu.
- All new texts are translated (Tiếng Việt / English / 简体中文 / Русский).
